data.exact_reserve_text: The 2012, 2013 and 2014 years of account have all shown a profit, with syndicate 1200 being the only syndicate showing a loss. The incoming 2011 and 2012 years of account of RITC produced a technical surplus following continuing favourable incurred development at an attritional level in a number of classes as well as favourable developments on certain individual losses.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Syndicate 1200 continued to show a loss and required high level of attention from claims and reinsurance teams due to ongoing claims.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net release of GBP 2.599 million in prior year reserves, representing 0.75% of opening gross reserves. This favourable development was primarily driven by continuing favourable incurred development for the 2011 and 2012 years of account, which produced a technical surplus, and also by profits on the 2012 and 2013 years of account. However, Syndicate 1200, a prior year issue, continued to show a loss and required significant attention.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable incurred development at an attritional level in a number of classes
favourable developments on certain individual losses
syndicate 1200 being the only syndicate showing a loss

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is a net figure derived from the sum of technical profits for the 2012 and 2013 years of account, as a gross figure was not explicitly stated or derivable from a claims development triangle.
